<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="1LYh0JpgHMz8ComPjMUR" name="Page-1"> <mxGraphModel dx="1093" dy="674" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
config:
 theme: redux-color
---

flowchart LR

 subgraph gALIGN[\"ALIGN READS TO REFERENCE\"]
 direction TB
 READS[/FASTQ READS<br><br>sr:Illumina<br>lr:PacBio|ONT/]
 REF[/REFERENCE GENOME<br><br>hg19|hg38|chm13/]

 ALIGN_REFERENCE[[\"ALIGN_REFERENCE<br>sr:bwa mem<br>lr:minimap2\"]]

 READS --> ALIGN_REFERENCE
 REF --> ALIGN_REFERENCE
 end

 CRAM[/WGS_ALIGNMENTS/]

 subgraph gCN[\"GET MT COPY NUMBER\"]
 direction TB
 COMPUTE_ALIGNMENT_STATS
 COMPUTE_MTDNA_COPY_NUMBER
 CALCULATE_SUBSAMPLING_RATE
 CN[/MTDNA-CN/]
 GET_HET_THOLD

 COMPUTE_ALIGNMENT_STATS --> COMPUTE_MTDNA_COPY_NUMBER --> CN --> GET_HET_THOLD
 COMPUTE_ALIGNMENT_STATS --> CALCULATE_SUBSAMPLING_RATE
 end

 R[/SUBSAMPLING_RATIO/]

 subgraph gREALIGN[\"REALIGN SAMPLED READS TO MT|NUMTS\"]
 direction TB
 RCRS[/<b>RCRS</b>/]
 NUMTS[/<b>NUMTS</b>/]

 FILTER_SUBSAMPLE_AND_TRIM
 REALIGN_CIRCULARIZED_MT
 REALIGN_NUMTS[\"REALIGN_NUMTS<br>sr\"]
 COMPARE_SCORES[\"COMPARE_SCORES<br>sr\"]
 SELECT_MT_READS[\"SELECT_MT_READS<br>sr|lr\"]
 FILTER_MT_ALIGNMENTS
 COMPUTE_MT_COVERAGE
 IDENTIFY_SPLIT_ALIGNMENTS[\"IDENTIFY_SPLIT_ALIGNMENTS<br>sr|lr\"]

 FILTER_SUBSAMPLE_AND_TRIM --> REALIGN_CIRCULARIZED_MT
 RCRS --> REALIGN_CIRCULARIZED_MT

 FILTER_SUBSAMPLE_AND_TRIM --> REALIGN_NUMTS
 NUMTS --> REALIGN_NUMTS

 REALIGN_CIRCULARIZED_MT --> COMPARE_SCORES
 REALIGN_NUMTS --> COMPARE_SCORES
 COMPARE_SCORES --> SELECT_MT_READS
 SELECT_MT_READS --> FILTER_MT_ALIGNMENTS
 FILTER_MT_ALIGNMENTS --> COMPUTE_MT_COVERAGE
 FILTER_MT_ALIGNMENTS --> IDENTIFY_SPLIT_ALIGNMENTS
 end

 BAM[/MT_ALIGNMENTS/]

 subgraph gCALL_SNVS[\"CALL SNVS\"]
 direction TB
 CALL_SNVS[[\"CALL SNVS:<br>sr:mutect2|freebayes|varscan<br>lr:deepsomatic|clairs-to\"]]
 NORMALIZE_SNVS
 ANNOTATE_SNVS[[\"ANNOTATE_SNVS:<br>Hom,Het<br>dbSNP,genes<br>MCC,MLC...\"]]

 CALL_SNVS --> NORMALIZE_SNVS
 NORMALIZE_SNVS --> ANNOTATE_SNVS
 end

 SNVS[/SNVS/]

 subgraph gMT[\"COMPUTE NEW MT\"]
 direction TB
 CHECK_CONTAMINATION{CHECK<br>CONTAMINATION}

 CHECK_CONTAMINATION --> |Yes|REMOVE_SAMPLE
 CHECK_CONTAMINATION --> |No|COMPUTE_SAMPLE_MT
 
 COMPUTE_SAMPLE_MT --> IDENTIFY_HAPLOGROUP
 end

 subgraph gMERGE_SNVS[\"ADD SAMPLE SNVS TO COLLECTION\"]
 direction TB
 MERGE_SNV_FILES --> FILTER_HET_THOLD --> COMPUTE_HET_STATISTICS
 end

 MT[/SAPLE_MT_CONSENSUS/]

 gALIGN -.-> CRAM
 CRAM --> gCN

 gCN --> CN
 gCN --> R

 R --> gREALIGN
 CRAM --> gREALIGN

 gREALIGN --> BAM --> gCALL_SNVS
 gCALL_SNVS --> SNVS --> gMT --> MT -->|2nd iteration| gREALIGN
 SNVS --> gMERGE_SNVS
 CHECK_CONTAMINATION --> |No| gMERGE_SNVS

 style gALIGN fill:#DCEEFF,stroke:#2F6DAE
 style gCN fill:#E2F3E4,stroke:#4B8B3B
 style gREALIGN fill:#FFF1CC,stroke:#B8860B
 style gCALL_SNVS fill:#E9DDF7,stroke:#7652A3
 style gMT fill:#FCE1D0,stroke:#C66A2B
 style gMERGE_SNVS fill:#A9ADA7,stroke:#7652A3
",
